prompts.title: Sky Runner
prompts.prompt: # Game Development Brief: "Sky Runner - Aviation Endless Runner"## Core ConceptBuild a 3D endless runner game inspired by Subway Surfers but with a CUSTOM AIRPLANE/THEME. Instead of running on train tracks, the player pilots a small aircraft through an aerial obstacle course.## Key Differences from Subway Surfers| Subway Surfers | Sky Runner (This Game) ||---------------|------------------------|| Ground-based running | Aerial flight mechanics || Train tracks | Sky lanes with cloud corridors || Jump/roll/dodge | Pitch up/down, barrel roll, boost || Coin collection | Fuel orbs + cargo packages || Police chase | Storm cloud pursuit system |## Game Mechanics1. **Movement:** 3-lane horizontal system (left, center, right) + vertical pitch control2. **Actions:** - Swipe Up: Climb altitude - Swipe Down: Dive - Swipe Left/Right: Change lanes - Double Tap: Barrel roll (invincibility frame)3. **Obstacles:** - Other aircraft (must dodge) - Storm clouds (slowdown zone) - Bird flocks (damage) - Air traffic control towers - Turbulence zones4. **Collectibles:** - Fuel orbs (extend run time) - Cargo crates (bonus points) - Golden propellers (currency) - Power-ups: Turbo boost, Shield, Magnet## Visual Style- **Art Direction:** Low-poly stylized 3D (like Subway Surfers but aviation-themed)- **Color Palette:** Sky blues, sunset oranges, cloud whites, metallic grays- **Environment:** Dynamic skybox with day/night cycle, volumetric clouds- **Player Character:** Customizable pilot with different aircraft skins- **UI:** Minimalist HUD, altitude meter, fuel gauge, score counter## Technical Stack- **Engine:** Unity 2023 LTS or Three.js (for web-based)- **Language:** C# (Unity) or JavaScript/TypeScript (Three.js)- **Physics:** Custom arcade physics (not realistic flight sim)- **Platform:** Mobile (iOS/Android) + Web GL- **Performance:** 60 FPS target, LOD system for distant objects## Required Features1. **Main Menu:** Hangar scene with aircraft selection2. **Game Loop:** Endless procedurally generated sky lanes3. **Progression:** Unlock new planes, pilots, and trails4. **Leaderboard:** Global and friend scores5. **Daily Challenges:** Specific mission types (collect X fuel, dodge Y birds)6. **Shop System:** In-game currency for cosmetics7. **Save System:** Cloud save for progress## Deliverables- Complete project structure- Player controller script with swipe gestures- Obstacle spawning system (object pooling)- Collision detection and damage system- UI manager (score, fuel, game over screen)- 3 sample aircraft models (placeholder or procedurally generated)- Background music + SFX placeholders## Unique Selling Points1. **Verticality:** Unlike Subway Surfers, players can change altitude2. **Aircraft Customization:** Wings, engines, paint jobs, contrail effects3. **Weather System:** Dynamic weather affects gameplay (rain = slippery, wind = lane drift)4. **Multiplayer Mode:** Real-time race against ghost data of other players# OutputGenerate the complete codebase structure, core gameplay scripts, and UI components. Include comments for easy customization. Make it modular for future feature additions.
